Package io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.factories

Class EventProcessorFactory

java.lang.Object
io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.factories.EventProcessorFactory
public final class EventProcessorFactory extends Object
Factory for event processor definitions and the runtime adapter that wraps a raw batch function into an EventProcessor.
